text.text: Good morning
This week: publish the trail season posts, finish the loyalty relaunch emails and review the gift guide plan.
This week
Active campaigns
Content calendar
Results
Leads
Everything headed for social channels.
Social rhythm
Three posts a week on the channel that earns the most; one on each of the others.
Reuse one idea in each format: a short video, a carousel and a story.
Reply to every comment within a day. It is the cheapest growth there is.
Phrases to rank for and the pages that target them.
How the SEO list works
Add a phrase people search for, with its monthly searches and difficulty.
Write one page that targets it and link the page to the phrase.
Check the rank once a month and note the change.
Start with phrases that have real searches and low difficulty; they pay back fastest.
Check ranks on the first Monday of each month.
Email and newsletter issues, with the same status flow as the rest of marketing.
Newsletter rhythm
Send on the same day and time every week; readers build the habit before you do.
One idea per issue. A single clear call to action beats five links.
Check opens and clicks the day after, and write down one thing to change.
Approved logos, photos and templates.
Using the asset library
Only approved assets go into published work.
Name files by what they show, not by date, so search finds them.
Tick Approved when the brand owner signs off, and update the date when you replace a file.
Content due this week is on track
Each active campaign has a status note
Leads from the past week have a follow-up
One keyword moves from Target to Writing
Unapproved assets are cleared
